market.question: Will the highest temperature in Denver be 45°F or below on May 5?

assessment.reasoning: NWS Denver forecast for May 5, 2026 calls for high near 73°F with partly sunny conditions. The market resolves YES if highest temp is 45°F or below, requiring nearly 30°F below forecast — extremely unlikely outside an unprecedented arctic blast (which is not on synoptic charts).
assessment.key_uncertainty: An unforecasted late-spring arctic outbreak with snow could only conceivably push high to mid-40s.
